primary_metric.name: MASE
primary_metric.forecast_error_numerator: mean absolute forecast error over the test window
primary_metric.scale_denominator: mean absolute seasonal-naive difference computed exclusively from the pre-test training window
primary_metric.seasonal_period: frozen metadata m; use m=1 for nonseasonal series

primary_comparison.primary_estimand: population median of paired MASE differences
primary_comparison.point_estimator: sample median of paired MASE differences
primary_comparison.confidence_interval: two-sided 95 percent exact/nonparametric order-statistic confidence interval for the median based on the binomial distribution
primary_comparison.ties: exact zero differences excluded from sign-test trial count and reported separately

synthetic_analysis_unit.optimizer_replicate_aggregation: median MASE within process x DGP-seed x noise condition
synthetic_analysis_unit.confirmatory_noise_aggregation: arithmetic mean across noise levels 0.05, 0.10, 0.20 after optimizer aggregation

failure_reporting.claim_language_if_failures_occur: accuracy inference is explicitly conditional on successful forecasts; operational failure rates must be interpreted jointly and cannot be hidden by pair deletion
